source.how: The figure's embedded image (756 x 1033 px) is georeferenced as for the Active Use Streets (20 signalised intersections, a local affine per inset, worst residual 18 ft). The stippled core fill was outlined on the image and carried onto the ground; every street centreline of active-use-streets.geojson was then polygonized into blocks, and a block is in a core when at least half of it lies inside the outline. So where the figure runs a core edge along a street (SE Blanton St, SE Cornelius Pass Rd's west carriageway, SE Reed Dr's Active Use 2A block and the Active Use 2 loop in the Town Center; SE Butternut Creek Pkwy, SE Vermont St and the Active Use 2 streets east and west of SE Cornelius Pass Rd in the Village Center), the boundary is that street's centreline, and lots across the street are outside. The Town Center's north edge (the stipple stops at the plan district boundary, short of SW Tualatin Valley Hwy) and west edge (a straight line north of the Active Use 2 street) follow no street and are the figure's own lines. SE Cornelius Pass Rd and SE Deline St run through the Village Center core; the Town Center's Active Use 1 streets run through its core.
source.check: Each core is the blocks the figure stipples and no other: Village Center 4 blocks, Town Center 5 (the sliver between SE Cornelius Pass Rd's two carriageways is outside, as the figure draws the core's east edge at the road). Outline against blocks: Village Center 30.6 acres outlined, 34.6 traced (the outline stops at the drawn street line's inner edge, the trace at the centreline); Town Center 39.3 and 43.2.
source.reading: A lot is inside when at least 90 percent of it lies within a core and outside when at most 10 percent does (flats.geom.drawn); a lot the line cuts is unanswered and held out of GREEN on hillsboro_center_core.
